name: Jude Zarzaur
bio: Jude is a Lebanese-American actor with a knack for accents and vocal nuances. In his first year of acting, Jude landed back-to-back lead voiceover roles in The Chosen Adventures series and an animated feature film. He also booked a live action role alongside Mark Wahlberg in an upcoming feature film. Jude has trained with dialect coaches, Jane Fujita and Melissa Grogan and has used Middle Eastern, Brooklyn, and General American accents in his roles. Jude loves exploring voice work and has his fingers crossed for the day when he gets to use his native Southern drawl.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
credits.overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

credits.title: By Any Means
credits.overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
credits.overview: When laidback Greg finds himself at odds with his dad's outsized expectations, pressure builds to turn his act around. After a series of hilarious near disasters, Greg's dad presents him with an ultimatum that just might challenge his wimpy ways for good.
